integrity: Analytical all-real-parameter proof with independent exact enumeration of all 4096 spin configurations at representative coupling/field values; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Zero-temperature equilibrium only; not a quantum or vector-spin theorem, finite-temperature phase transition, random-bond result or thermodynamic-limit result. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_scope: Exactly twelve classical Ising spins on the two-edge-orbit truncated-tetrahedral graph with positive intratriangle exchange J, positive bridge exchange K, uniform real field h, and no other interactions.
title: Universal one-third plateau and critical degeneracies on the truncated-tetrahedral Ising cluster
